criteria.text: Each retained finding has observable acceptance and exact evidence; all child fixes are delivered and verified at their actual source/runtime boundary, or an explicitly approved deferral preserves the requirement outside the completion claim. No silent deletion of user content, cross-tenant credentials, duplicate confirmed external writes, false-success UI or false-green worker health. Preserve historical Temporal contracts and active data. Reuse exact matching proof; changed release uses repository acceptance. Keep original epics open while their unrelated criteria remain unmet.

USER/EDITOR and disabled memberships cannot retrieve an organization credential from list/switch DTOs; explicit admin API-key surface remains functional. Use two tenants/current roles and prove denied public mutation with a key that was never disclosed. Existing exposed-key remediation is assessed separately, never rotate live keys blindly.

An edit to Post.content or derivation body/version between read and update is retained and counted skipped. Unchanged machine render updates once. Use atomic compare on exact read inputs; no forced backfill or live customer mutation.

Read errors have localized retry distinct from successful empty data; denied/5xx delete never shows success or clears extension credentials. USER keeps preview but no write controls, EDITOR works. No-group compatibility is coherent with actual server target if that shape is supported. Preserve common fetch response contract; prove affected actions with denied/network/5xx/success cases.

Network/protocol/HTTP failures end loader, show useful localized retry and never false success. Intended login, reset send contract and OAuth registration still work. No real email/account/provider calls needed for focused proof.

Deleted/disabled/reconnected channel rejects stale refresh before provider calls and never resurrects. New refresh writes use the established encrypted format; valid connection refresh and legacy reads continue. Use synthetic token/cookies and two generations, preserve secret history safely; no real accounts or global JWT rotation.

Packaged extension obtains least necessary explicit/optional backend host permission and validates stored URL; actual background renewal reaches controlled mock backend and reports failures. Prove production manifest/build with a browser extension fixture, no real Skool credentials and no broad wildcard/all-host grant.

After scheduling then disabling plug/channel/provider switch, wake invokes zero provider operations and records a safe skip. Enabled action still runs. Gate at execution and provider-specific switch; preserve old Temporal commands/contracts and never auto-cancel unrelated histories.

Versioned successor respects absolute deadlines/elapsed processing time for several plugs and repeat, has no negative sleeps and preserves declared repeat base. Virtual-clock proof includes nonzero processing. Historical V101–V105 exports/replay remain unchanged and new starts migrate deliberately.

Different local/provider IDs yield intended tenant post URL/state in event; failed delivery is visible. Keep identifiers explicit, version workflow/activity/consumer meaning safely, retain already-running histories. Fake HTTP proof does not claim actual customer delivery.

Only matching acknowledged signed event produces completed with its ID; older events, all failures and empty EOSE cannot report success. Connections close, comments retain linkage, uncertain retry uses same event where protocol permits. No historical auto-republish or real relay calls required for local acceptance.

First/middle failure preserves original secret, marks reconnect and permits later valid channels; command exposes partial result. Dribbble expiry never requests Pinterest: use documented Dribbble refresh or explicit reconnect-only capability. Preserve flat refreshToken activity alias/history; no real token mutations.

Reset/activation tokens never authenticate sessions; expiry is enforced and reset cannot be reused after successful reset. Explicitly handle existing token shapes without inventing a secret rotation or silently breaking active legitimate sessions. Prove valid session, wrong purpose, expired and reused reset, and post-password-change behavior with synthetic credentials.

Versioned periodic successors rotate after bounded processed attempts while preserving input/queue state, including failure-heavy mail. Virtual clock/counters and compatibility proof retain original exports; inspect actual owned consumers before migration. No blanket replacement/cancellation of live workflows or invented incident/limit.

Two-tenant fake R2 sessions cannot cross sign/list/complete/abort; legitimate retry/completion works with expiry. Avatar accepts active media only from a workspace with current membership (including own alternate workspace), rejects foreign/deleted without user update. No live bucket/upload/account mutation; keep existing media retention.

With enabled existing synthetic allowance1 and overlapping requests, one reservation/provider effect; preserve failure/refund and current unbilled behavior. No new price/trial/payment policy or live paid requests. Use DB concurrency proof and provider fake; do not hold transaction across provider call.

Mismatched provider/platform rejects before Post/ContentDerivation writes; matching active channel works. Existing capability mapping is the source, no new generic provider routing. Prove supported alias family and a Telegram/VK mismatch.

Synthetic recipient/prompt/cookie sentinels absent in success/failure stdout; fixed safe outcome/code and opaque correlation preserve useful diagnosis/delivery/retry. No live messages/provider calls/global log settings. Do not claim30-day retention from redacted logs.

Ordinary startup never mutates schema or deletes all owners processes. Destructive dev commands require an explicit verified disposable/local target and dry-run/intent; production/ambiguous URL rejects before subprocess. Local developers retain safe setup/reset path and docs agree; test with fake commands only, no live DB or shared PM2 changes.

Define usable status/code/retry surface while preserving documented409/client compatibility (version/opt-in if needed); prove401/409/503/non-JSON with offline transport and own SDK build/types. No publish-package or public breaking change without a deliberate delivery/compatibility step.

Offer explicit compatible strict/check exit mode: invalid fixture nonzero, valid zero, help/offline validation opens no DB/Temporal/provider socket. Preserve normal command lifecycle; verify actual compiled CLI without a Prisma-connect stub and document boundary.

Inventory exact current callers/CI/build and owned persisted provider/version usage read-only; remove or archive only truly unused targets and add concise support boundary for retained code. No donor rebrand/history rewrite or automatic user/provider-row deletion. SDK/extension acceptance remains explicit, not inferred from main build.

Each chosen release batch has code/affected proof, repository full release gate only when actually releasing, exact private/public/image/runtime correspondence, health and working rollback; no unverified all-done claim. Final child task acceptance references all delivered fixes and explicitly accepted defers. Never restore backups, change shared global logs or connect/publish real social accounts as a blanket delivery test.

Removed/disabled membership rejects old token, USER cannot mutate, EDITOR/ADMIN retain only existing policy permissions. Two-tenant and downgrade cases prove current DB state governs each request. Preserve supported legacy clients; never modify MCP authorization as a workaround.

Untrusted-origin cookie-auth mutations are rejected before model/provider/data/key effects. Intended frontend, server clients, OAuth callbacks and bearer APIs still work under their own contracts. Prove form POST and JSON/preflight cases with synthetic sessions and zero provider effects; SameSite/CORS alone must not substitute for the server boundary.

Two organizations with the same external account retain distinct secrets/state after one refresh. Same-organization unrelated provider collisions remain untouched; intentional LinkedIn account/page sharing continues only in its documented family. Verify actual Prisma predicates and concurrent/refresh/connect cases without real providers.

A confirmed provider write followed by streak failure produces exactly one local write call and a durable provider receipt; auxiliary failure is separate. Cover crash/uncertain response with reconciliation rather than blind retry. Add versioned workflow/activity and migrate new starts; preserve old histories. Fake proof is distinguished from actual provider idempotency.

Bounded readiness distinguishes worker/process or stale/missing pollers from an idle healthy queue; stopped worker is visibly unavailable and recovery clears it. Use native isolated image/Temporal and pending safe workflow. No production fault injection/global monitoring changes/backup restore; do not add heavy probes or alter32+1 queue/cap contracts.

Triage by actual runtime/platform/caller, prioritize exposed dependencies, select minimum compatible patched versions and prove affected behavior. Explicitly dismiss Windows-only/unused next/og/custom-server cases where justified; account for shipped build-only packages separately. Lockfile/install/build/affected tests and next release acceptance pass. No blind latest/forced audit fix or new framework rewrite.

Immediate navigation plus rejected/interrupted save does not discard the only dirty text; actionable retry or recoverable local draft exists. Successful saves/normal navigation remain simple. Check both core/adaptation without adding confirmation on every normal navigation.

scope_note: All original epic criteria preserved. Only dbxe.6 is selected; no release acceptance or delivery authority inferred.
